project.name: Gimle Ragnarok
project.description: The chaos-testing engine (Fenrir) and stress/load-testing engine (Surtr) as a shipping library, decoupled from gimle-holmgang's own in-JVM test harness behind the ClusterTarget seam so the same engines can eventually be pointed at a real, already-running cluster. Phase 1 of the extraction: the seam and the two engines move here unchanged in behavior; the harness-only Loki network-fault interposition and process-control faults stay available only to a ClusterTarget backed by a harness-owned cluster (gimle-holmgang's own GimleCluster) -- an adapter with no process control of its own reports that honestly rather than failing.
